units.source_text: 此时正是秋季“司召”之期，

en.t: At this time it was precisely the autumn season for the Shimeshi appointments,

units.source_text: 京官任免，须在此时决定。

en.t: and the appointment and dismissal of officials in the capital had to be decided then.

units.source_text: 左大臣也须入宫参与会议。

en.t: The Minister of the Left also had to enter the palace to take part in the meetings.
The young gentlemen all hoped for promotion,

units.source_text: 时刻不离左右，此时大家跟着左大臣入宫。

en.t: so they never left his side, and now they all followed the Minister of the Left into the palace.

units.source_text: 诸人入宫之后，邸内人少，顿觉岑寂。

en.t: After everyone had gone to the palace, the residence was sparsely populated and suddenly felt desolate.

units.source_text: 正在此时，葵姬的病忽然转剧，

en.t: Just then, Lady Aoi's illness suddenly worsened,
she wheezed and coughed in her chest, and the suffering was unbearable.

units.source_text: 不及向宫中通报，就断气了！

en.t: Before word could even be sent to the palace, she breathed her last!
